name: certificate-manager-gcp
description: Certificate management system on Google Cloud

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n emulators,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:emulators" "npm run dev -w @certificate-manager/api" "npm run dev -w @certificate-manager/web"
scripts.dev:lite: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @certificate-manager/api" "npm run dev -w @certificate-manager/web"
scripts.test:e2e:auth: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-certificate-manager "npm run seed:dev && E2E_AUTH_EMULATOR=true E2E_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.test E2E_ADMIN_PASSWORD=local-admin-password VITE_USE_AUTH_EMULATOR=true npm run test:e2e -w @certificate-manager/web"
